note: VARIANT with front legs: in this version the frog ALSO has two small, short front legs (arms), overriding the 'no arms' rule above. NEAR front leg: a short chubby green arm that comes out of the side of the body just below the left end of the mouth line and reaches down to the ground at the lower-centre-left, in front of the near thigh, ending in a small hand with three round fingers planted flat on the ground; it must NOT cover the tongue and must stay left of it with clear cream belly between them. FAR front leg: only the small three-fingered hand peeks out at the ground on the lower-right, in front of the far foot. Everything else exactly as described.
